status: provisional regression budgets, defined from Session 1; not acceptance
metric: active pointer event to next animation-frame callback after observed node/path attribute mutation
limitations: Pre-paint proxy, not raster paint. Samples are mutation callbacks, not independent gestures. Failed/unreachable actions do not supply latency samples. Planner invocations, graph remounts and listener leakage not measured.
variation: p95 allows 14.8 ms (32.7%) over reference; max allows 32.3 ms (67.7%). Recalibrate only with repeated controlled measurements, recording hardware/browser and cause. A 16.7 ms frame remains a responsiveness target, not a achieved result.
saveBudget: At most 19 layout-update frames for the fixed routing/combined/reload/renderer sequence before drill-down; reference was 15. Action snapshot counts can lag asynchronous saves; not a per-gesture transaction proof.
